description: Header file defining classes and functions for file and directory operations, including platform-specific handling for Windows and POSIX systems, as well as partition information retrieval.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a file with methods for creation, opening, reading, writing, and attribute management, with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Represents a directory with methods for creation, existence check, iteration, and deletion, supporting Linux and Windows.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Provides information about disk partitions, including size, free space, and validation, with platform-specific details.

methods.name: ParsePathInfo
methods.description: Parses a path string with embedded permission info into separate path and permission components.

methods.name: File::Normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a filename string, ensuring consistent formatting.

methods.name: File::FileName
methods.description: Extracts the filename from a full path.

methods.name: File::FileNameExtended
methods.description: Returns the filename with extension from a full path.

methods.name: File::PathName
methods.description: Returns the directory path from a full filename.

methods.name: File::Extension
methods.description: Returns the file extension from a filename.

methods.name: File::ErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the last error code from the platform-specific API.

methods.name: File::IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the file handle is open.

methods.name: File::Exists
methods.description: Checks if the file exists based on attributes.

methods.name: File::IsReadOnly
methods.description: Checks if the file is read-only.

methods.name: File::IsHidden
methods.description: Checks if the file is hidden.

methods.name: File::IsSystem
methods.description: Checks if the file is a system file.

methods.name: File::IsArchive
methods.description: Checks if the file is an archive.

methods.name: File::IsDirectory
methods.description: Checks if the file is a directory.

methods.name: File::IsLink
methods.description: Checks if the file is a symbolic link.

methods.name: File::IsCompressed
methods.description: Checks if the file is compressed (Windows only).

methods.name: File::IsEncrypted
methods.description: Checks if the file is encrypted (Windows only).

methods.name: File::Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: File::SetSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: File::Create
methods.description: Creates a new file with default or specified mode.

methods.name: File::Open (readOnly)
methods.description: Opens the file with specified read-only mode.

methods.name: File::Position
methods.description: Gets the current file pointer position.

methods.name: File::Permission
methods.description: Gets permission bits based on flags.
